criteria.text: Move the Chats title actions, project selector, and lifecycle selector into the Agents top-right overflow menu; keep Search chats visible.
criteria.test_id: issue-1285-c1: Agents overflow owns chat actions and selectors while Search chats stays visible

criteria.text: Desktop-created human sessions appear in Chats, while scheduled/background/system executions remain in their intended Activity/categories.
criteria.test_id: issue-1285-c2: desktop human sessions compose into Chats without leaking scheduled or optimizer runs

criteria.text: Review Queue and Gallery render the same authorized real data available on desktop instead of a false empty state.
criteria.test_id: issue-1285-c3: Review Queue and Gallery load the authorized records visible on desktop

criteria.text: Skills, MCP Servers, Agent Profiles, and Providers & Models provide search, organization/grouping, and deterministic sorting.
criteria.test_id: issue-1285-c4: large tool catalogs expose search grouping and deterministic A-Z sorting

criteria.text: Providers & Models clearly explains and limits its catalog to the providers/models actually configured or available in Rhythm.
criteria.test_id: issue-1285-c5: Providers & Models explains and limits the catalog to configured or available entries

criteria.text: Physical-device Metro console has no React Fragment prop errors or invalid icon-name warnings on these paths.
criteria.test_id: issue-1285-c6: native Agents and Tools paths cannot emit Fragment-prop or invalid-icon warnings

criteria.text: An exact-owner projectless desktop human chat discovered in mobile Chats can be opened and its transcript can be read without treating it as missing from the selected project.
criteria.test_id: issue-1285-c7: owner-discovered projectless chat opens with its transcript

criteria.text: An exact-owner projectless desktop human chat is interactive from mobile, while retaining projectId null and using a separate registered-project routing context for gateway authorization.
criteria.test_id: issue-1285-c8: projectless owner chats remain interactive with separate routing context

criteria.text: The Opening chat screen always exposes Back to chats, which cancels the in-flight open and returns to Agents.
criteria.test_id: issue-1285-c9: opening chat exposes a working Back to chats action

criteria.text: Opening a chat becomes ready after its bounded message page loads; diff, todos, permissions, and questions refresh afterward and cannot hold the opening screen hostage.
criteria.test_id: issue-1285-c10: initial open awaits messages only and defers supplemental state

criteria.text: Chats publishes the first 10 owner sessions immediately, then merges remaining owner pages and project batches progressively without keeping the initial list loader active.
criteria.test_id: issue-1285-c11: first ten chats publish before delayed catalog pages
